title: Spokes on Saturn's B Ring
explanation: Don’t get spooked by Saturn’s ghostly spokes! Today we feature a nearly two-hour timelapse of Saturn and its rings looping forwards and backwards. If you look closely, a ghoulish shadow appears and disappears as  Saturn’s B ring  rotates. Decades of observation with  Voyager 2,  Cassini, and Hubble  show the appearance of Saturn’s spokes varies with  the planet’s seasons.
